subject: Missed architecture review — can we rebook?
messages:

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Architecture deep-dive (Acme Health & Redwood) — 30m invite

Hi Olivia & Mei,

Thanks again for the time — sending a calendar invite for a 30-minute architecture deep-dive to align on integration points and expected performance for the pilot. Suggested agenda:

- 5m intros & scope
- 10m high-level architecture and network considerations
- 10m walk through sample request flow and token budget expectations
- 5m next steps / action items

Marissa (SE) will lead the demo and walk the network diagram. I attached the slide deck we plan to use.

Attachments: arch-review-slide-deck.pdf (pdf)

If any of these times don't work I can move — proposed slot is today at 10:30 AM PT.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Hi Olivia / Mei,

We started the call at 10:30 and were on the line for ~15 minutes — it looks like Acme couldn't make it. No problem, I know calendars get busy.

Can you share a quick note if you'd still like to do the deep-dive? If so, here's what works for us in the next 48 hours:
- Thu 2/19 9:00–9:30 AM PT
- Thu 2/19 1:30–2:00 PM PT
- Fri 2/20 10:00–10:30 AM PT

Marissa is standing by to focus on the network diagram and latency considerations. If none of those work, tell me a few windows that do and we'll accommodate.

If you prefer, we can also record a short 15-min walkthrough and share notes.

Thanks,
Camila

So sorry — we had an urgent clinical ops issue that pulled Mei and I into an incident call. Apologies for the no-show. We definitely want to do the deep-dive; the pilot depends on the network/firewall requirements you mentioned.

The earliest that works for both of us is Thu 2/19 1:30 PM PT. Can you confirm and send a new invite? Also, would you be able to share the network diagram and any example request volumes ahead of time? That will help our infra team scope firewall rules.
